# Spec

## Summary
The card that documents a code export: a `ref` (module + export name), a
`specType` (card | field | component | command | app), a markdown `readMe`,
and examples (contained for field values, linked for card instances). Specs
are how a realm declares "this export is a supported, documented surface" —
this very tracker verifies concepts by resolving their Specs' refs.

## Invariants
- `ref.module` may be relative (resolved against the Spec's location) or an
  absolute URL; the search index always reports it resolved-absolute.
- `containedExamples` entries must be typed FieldDef values (primitives are
  rejected at validation).

## Example
```ts
import { Spec } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/spec';
```
```json
{
  "attributes": {
    "specType": "field",
    "ref": { "module": "../score-field", "name": "default" },
    "readMe": "# Score …"
  },
  "meta": { "adoptsFrom": { "module": "https://cardstack.com/base/spec", "name": "Spec" } }
}
```
